pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition on adding positions within 0.15% of an established macro liquidity node or during high-frequency ATR expansion phases.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero entry authorization unless confirmed by a multi-timeframe order flow imbalance and a realized volatility contraction filter below the 20-period ATR median.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate automated partial scale-outs and tighten trailing stops immediately once floating profit crosses +$10.00 to prevent positive drift erosion.
